prose: Tom Barnett is a master of the flow state, and teaches people to build their optimized self through movement, breathing, nutrition, thinking, feeling, and rest. As simple as these things may be, most of us are doing them wrong in some way. In this episode we talk about combining these elements to upgrade our bodies and the consciousness driving them, we discuss male monthly energy cycles and how the moon relates, strategies for balancing work outs with "working in," and we riff on sexual health and the pitfalls of modern times.
ext: We look at how lock-downs in Australia have surpassed the tyranny in the states, what we can do to resist draconian measures, what the world may look like if many people do wake up (or if they don't), germ theory vs. terrain theory, and celibacy compared to self knowledge and self control.
